metric_definitions.lap_time: Discrete simulation steps for completed episodes only. Incomplete episodes are excluded (no artificial penalty).
metric_definitions.offtrack_failure_rate: Fraction of episodes terminating due to track boundary crossing (crashed==True) out of total episodes.
metric_definitions.timeout_rate: Fraction of episodes reaching max_steps (700) without crashing or completing.
metric_definitions.stationary_rate: Fraction of episodes timing out with max_speed < 0.05 or abs(lap_progress) < 0.005.
metric_definitions.completion_rate: Fraction of episodes reaching 100% lap progress.

contrast_directions.lap_time: Negative effect indicates faster performance (fewer simulation steps).
contrast_directions.offtrack_failure_rate: Negative effect indicates reduction in failures (fewer off-track crashes).

statistical_methods.paired_circuits: Comparisons are matched on identical circuit seeds (1001..1010).
statistical_methods.confidence_intervals: 95% paired bootstrap percentile interval with B=10,000 resamples (seed 42).
statistical_methods.hypothesis_tests: Paired Student's t-test and exact Wilcoxon signed-rank permutation test.
statistical_methods.critical_limitation: Single training seed (42) per condition. Intervals reflect test-circuit variation, not RL training seed stochasticity.
